name: Isobar
author: atsokolas
description: The weather, drawn in your theme — a sky that moves, a forecast in a sentence, and the next 24 hours at a glance.

barWidget.description: The sky and the temperature on the bar; the day ahead in the panel.

schema.label: Units
schema.description: Automatic follows your locale: °F and mph in the US, °C and km/h elsewhere.

schema.label: Rain hint on the bar
schema.description: "Rain in 20m" beside the temperature, only when it's coming.

schema.label: Heads-up before rain
schema.description: A quiet toast half an hour before rain or snow arrives.

schema.label: Open hour by hour
schema.description: The panel opens on the hours, which scroll and settle one at a time, rather than the overview.

schema.label: Weather alerts
schema.description: Warnings and advisories from the US National Weather Service: a red band in the panel, a mark on the bar, and a toast once per alert. Outside the US there is no free feed, so nothing shows.

schema.label: Firsts of the season
schema.description: A quiet toast for the first frost, the first snow, the first warm day in months — a few times a year.

schema.label: Notes from your places
schema.description: A toast when it snows, storms, or gets truly hot or cold somewhere you keep an eye on. Routine rain isn't news.

schema.label: Moving sky
schema.description: Rays turn and rain falls while you hover or the panel is open.
